contactGroups.carrierDefender: logical body-pair contact between carrier and defender
contactGroups.carrierGround: logical body-pair contact between carrier and ground
contactGroups.defenderGround: logical body-pair contact between defender and ground

method.pairCountDefinition: One logical body pair counts as one pair even when Rapier reports multiple collider-pair manifolds. manifoldCount and contactPointCount preserve lower-level multiplicity.
method.rapierImpulse: Exact solver-reported normal contact impulse summed over contact points using TempContactManifold.contactImpulse(i).
method.joltImpulse: Estimate from pre/post relative contact-point velocity change divided by linear inverse-mass sum, with gravity delta removed. Jolt JS exposes manifold geometry in callbacks but not its solved normal lambda; this estimate excludes angular effective mass and cannot separate simultaneous contact contributions. Treat it as a diagnostic estimate, not a solver impulse.
method.contactTiming: Rapier manifolds are queried after each fixed step. Jolt OnContactAdded/OnContactPersisted callbacks capture the current step manifold.
method.kinematicControl: The kinematic defender has the same initial pose and geometry. The carrier starts at rest and the defender moves toward it at the requested relative closing speed; dynamic mode exactly matches the carrier-moving sweep setup.
method.peakPhase: The dynamic mode peak tick/tilt is compared with the corresponding existing tilt-traces.json frame. The contact phase is read from this probe at the same tick.
method.reversalRule: For Jolt at 60°, reversal means carrier peak tilt at 4 m/s > 6 m/s and 8 m/s > 6 m/s.
